d97ebd83193f72c5e710fd12a472a6e1651e2fab.sourceText: 正确的上游配准和机械TF应让独立云台yaw转动后的静态环境仍转换到底盘方向；不能对这份点再手工重复加一个云台角。MID360挂在gimbal_yaw、随yaw不随pitch转动，两条odom关节固定的机械约定继续适用。
d97ebd83193f72c5e710fd12a472a6e1651e2fab.translatedText: Correct upstream registration and mechanical TF should ensure that the static environment, after the independent gimbal yaw rotation, is still transformed into the chassis frame; you must not manually add another gimbal angle to this point cloud again\. The MID360 is mounted at gimbal_yaw and rotates with yaw but not with pitch; the mechanical convention of the two fixed odom joints continues to apply\.

d9bb429bc6e449076fc9af3ef53c46519c41ce9a.sourceText:
RViz 的 Fixed Frame 理解成 “我站在哪个坐标系里看整个世界？”
而点云坐标系是`frame_id = front_mid360`，
也就是说，每一帧原始点云都是“以雷达自身为原点”描述的。
d9bb429bc6e449076fc9af3ef53c46519c41ce9a.translatedText: Understand RViz's Fixed Frame as "In which coordinate system am I standing to view the entire world?" And the point cloud coordinate system is`frame_id = front_mid360`， That is to say, each frame of the raw point cloud is described "with the lidar itself as the origin"\.

d9e49ae109b627bcf2f6324f9799325ef1aedc15.sourceText: 8项自定义参数仅在构造时读取，没有动态参数更新回调；运行时写同名参数不会更新成员、重建话题或改变初始自旋。ROS标准的 `use_sim_time` 由节点时钟处理，运行时改变自旋应通过 `cmd_spin`，两者不要混淆。
d9e49ae109b627bcf2f6324f9799325ef1aedc15.translatedText: The 8 custom parameters are read only at construction time, with no dynamic parameter update callback; writing a parameter with the same name at runtime will not update members, rebuild the topic, or change the initial spin\. ROS standard `use_sim_time` is handled by the node clock; changing the spin at runtime should be done via `cmd_spin`; do not confuse the two\.

d9ed88b13296dd14d3921fd0fe1d32df25bbee4e.translatedText: Design and implement a calculator class that performs operations on two operands using both the ordinary approach and polymorphism, respectively\.
